title: Readout adaptation in simulated arm reaching: code and data for the six-method, 400-epoch comparison
description: Complete code and experimental data for Readout adaptation in simulated arm reaching: learned compensation and performance after updates stop. This GitHub release snapshot includes the reproduction source, 65 model checkpoints, per-instance results, protocol and model manifests, a dependency lockfile, numerical figures, tables, validation reports, and three native TikZ diagrams. Six adaptive variants use three selection seeds and ten independent evaluation seeds under three curl force fields. All three CfC configurations were trained for 400 epochs. The recorded dataset contains 783 online protocols and 60 diagnostic reruns. Code license: MIT; see LICENSE files.
